description.zh: 将一个主题制作成可审阅、可继续制作的 Vox 风格 B-roll 解说片。
description.en: Turn a topic into a reviewable, continuously producible Vox-style B-roll explainer.

description.zh: 在本机将图片或视频转换为可预览的深度图，再按需保存到素材库。
description.en: Convert images or videos into previewable depth maps locally, saving them to the media library as needed.

description.zh: 把选题、文案和素材编排成可审阅、可实时预览、可导出的 Remotion 程序化视频。
description.en: Arrange a topic, script and assets into a reviewable, live-previewable, exportable Remotion programmatic video.

description.zh: 本地转写、声音角色与配音：把音视频转成字幕和可编辑文稿，再让角色朗读新文本。
description.en: Local transcription, voice characters and dubbing: turn audio or video into subtitles and an editable transcript, then have a character read new text.

zh.title: 运行前请确认设备条件
items: 基础转写建议至少 16 GB 内存；要稳定创建声音角色和合成配音，建议 32 GB 及以上。8 GB 内存或较旧设备不建议下载。
建议至少预留 15 GB 磁盘空间；Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 连同时间戳对齐器约 3.5 GB，CosyVoice2-0.5B 约 1 GB，Python 运行环境和缓存还会占用额外空间；下载多个模型需要更多空间。
想要较快的 Qwen 转写，推荐 Windows / Linux 上具备 8 GB 以上显存的 NVIDIA CUDA 显卡。纯 CPU 与 Apple 芯片 Mac 也能运行，但当前版本不会使用 Apple GPU 加速，Qwen 和配音会明显更慢。
zh.note: 模型在本机运行。安装 App 不会下载权重；只有你在声音工坊中选择模型后才会下载。

en.title: Check your hardware before you start
items: Basic transcription is best with at least 16 GB of RAM; for stable voice-character creation and dubbing, 32 GB or more is recommended. Devices with 8 GB or older hardware are not recommended.

Reserve at least 15 GB of disk space; Qwen3-ASR 0.6B plus the timestamp aligner is about 3.5 GB, CosyVoice2-0.5B about 1 GB, and the Python runtime and caches add more. Downloading multiple models needs more space.

For faster Qwen transcription, an NVIDIA CUDA GPU with 8 GB+ VRAM on Windows/Linux is recommended. CPU-only and Apple Silicon Macs also work, but this version does not use Apple GPU acceleration, so Qwen and dubbing will be noticeably slower.
en.note: Models run locally. Installing the App does not download weights; they are only downloaded after you pick a model in Audio Studio.
